segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Good morning, children. Sit down quietly. Today we will do Mathematics, chapter four, place value. Take out your books.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Good morning, madam.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Open page forty-two. Everybody look at the board. I will write a number. Thirty-four. Say it after me. Thirty-four.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Thirty-four.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Again. Thirty-four.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Thirty-four.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Three tens and four ones. Say it. Three tens and four ones.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Three tens and four ones.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Again. Three tens and four ones.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Three tens and four ones.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Good. Now copy the table from the board into your notebooks. Tens, ones. Write neatly. Do not talk.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Quiet, quiet. Write fast, we have very little time today.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Now we will do addition. Thirty-four plus nineteen. Who can tell me the answer? Raise your hand.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Nobody? Rohan, you stand up. What is thirty-four plus nineteen?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Madam... forty... forty-nine?

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: No. Sit down. Anybody else? Sneha?

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Fifty... fifty-seven, madam.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Wrong again. Listen, everyone. You add the ones, four plus nine, thirteen. Write three, carry one. Then three plus one plus one is five. The answer is fifty-three. Say it. Fifty-three.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Fifty-three.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Again. Fifty-three.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Fifty-three.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Now copy this sum from the board and do five more sums like this one. Do not ask me why we carry. Just remember the rule.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Madam, why do we write the one above the tens?

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: I said do not ask, Rohan. Just copy the rule. Is that clear?

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Yes, madam.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Who has finished? Show me your notebooks. Hmm, only four children. The rest are still copying from the board. Fine, fine.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Tomorrow we will do thirty-six plus twenty-seven in the same way. Remember, you do not need to understand it, you only need to practise the steps.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Now, the table of two. Say with me. Two ones are two.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Two ones are two. Two twos are four. Two threes are six. Two fours are eight.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Louder! Two ones are two.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Two ones are two. Two twos are four. Two threes are six. Two fours are eight. Two fives are ten.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Again from the beginning. Two ones are two.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Two ones are two. Two twos are four. Two threes are six. Two fours are eight. Two fives are ten. Two sixes are twelve.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Good. Now the table of three. Three ones are three.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Three ones are three. Three twos are six. Three threes are nine.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Shh, shh. The class next door can hear you. Sit properly. Hands on the desk.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Homework. Page forty-three, all the questions, and write the table of three ten times. Tomorrow I will check every notebook. Who does not finish will stand outside.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Yes, madam.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: The bell will ring now. Put your books away. Class dismissed.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Thank you, madam.
